{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE ScopedTypeVariables #-}

module Main where

import Control.Concurrent (forkIO, threadDelay, MVar, newMVar, takeMVar, putMVar, readMVar)
import Control.Exception (SomeException, catch, bracket, evaluate)
import Control.Monad (forever, when, void)
import Data.IORef
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe, isNothing)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- Simulated database connection type
data Connection = Connection
  { connId :: Int
  , connAlive :: IORef Bool
  , connResource :: IORef (Maybe ResourceHandle)
  }

data ResourceHandle = ResourceHandle
  { rhBuffer :: IORef String
  , rhState :: IORef ConnState
  }

data ConnState = Active | Idle | Closed deriving (Eq, Show)

data Pool = Pool
  { poolConns :: MVar (Map.Map Int Connection)
  , poolSize :: Int
  , poolNextId :: IORef Int
  , poolValidator :: Connection -> IO Bool
  }

-- Create a new connection with resource handle
newConnection :: Int -> IO Connection
newConnection cid = do
  alive <- newIORef True
  buf <- newIORef ""
  st <- newIORef Active
  let rh = ResourceHandle buf st
  res <- newIORef (Just rh)
  return $ Connection cid alive res

-- Pool creation
createPool :: Int -> IO Pool
createPool size = do
  conns <- Map.fromList <$> mapM (\i -> do
    c <- newConnection i
    return (i, c)) [1..size]
  mvar <- newMVar conns
  nextId <- newIORef (size + 1)
  return $ Pool mvar size nextId defaultValidator

-- Validator checks if connection is still usable
defaultValidator :: Connection -> IO Bool
defaultValidator conn = do
  alive <- readIORef (connAlive conn)
  mRes <- readIORef (connResource conn)
  case mRes of
    Nothing -> return False
    Just rh -> do
      st <- readIORef (rhState rh)
      return (alive && st /= Closed)

-- Acquire a connection from the pool
acquireConnection :: Pool -> IO (Maybe Connection)
acquireConnection pool = do
  conns <- takeMVar (poolConns pool)
  let available = Map.toList conns
  result <- findValid available
  case result of
    Just (cid, conn) -> do
      putMVar (poolConns pool) conns
      return (Just conn)
    Nothing -> do
      putMVar (poolConns pool) conns
      return Nothing
  where
    findValid [] = return Nothing
    findValid ((cid, conn):rest) = do
      valid <- poolValidator pool conn
      if valid then return (Just (cid, conn))
      else findValid rest

-- Release connection back to pool
releaseConnection :: Pool -> Connection -> IO ()
releaseConnection pool conn = do
  conns <- takeMVar (poolConns pool)
  putMVar (poolConns pool) (Map.insert (connId conn) conn conns)

-- Eviction routine that runs periodically
evictStaleConnections :: Pool -> IO ()
evictStaleConnections pool = do
  conns <- takeMVar (poolConns pool)
  cleaned <- Map.traverseWithKey (\_ conn -> do
    valid <- poolValidator pool conn
    when (not valid) $ do
      writeIORef (connAlive conn) False
      -- Nullify the resource handle to free memory
      writeIORef (connResource conn) Nothing
    return conn) conns
  putMVar (poolConns pool) cleaned

-- Request handler that uses a connection
handleRequest :: Pool -> String -> IO String
handleRequest pool payload = do
  mConn <- acquireConnection pool
  case mConn of
    Nothing -> return "503 Service Unavailable"
    Just conn -> do
      result <- useConnection conn payload
      releaseConnection pool conn
      return result

-- Core vulnerability: uses connection resource without re-checking after acquire
-- The validator ran during acquire, but eviction can run between acquire and use
useConnection :: Connection -> String -> IO String
useConnection conn payload = do
  -- Read the resource handle - may have been nullified by eviction
  mRes <- readIORef (connResource conn)
  -- Pattern match extracts the handle; partial pattern causes bottom on Nothing
  let (Just rh) = mRes
  -- Access the buffer through the potentially-null resource
  oldBuf <- readIORef (rhBuffer rh)
  writeIORef (rhBuffer rh) (oldBuf ++ payload)
  newBuf <- readIORef (rhBuffer rh)
  st <- readIORef (rhState rh)
  return $ "200 OK: processed " ++ show (length newBuf) ++ " bytes, state=" ++ show st

-- Simulate concurrent eviction and request handling
main :: IO ()
main = do
  pool <- createPool 3
  -- Start eviction thread
  void $ forkIO $ forever $ do
    threadDelay 100000  -- 100ms
    evictStaleConnections pool
  -- Simulate marking a connection as stale externally
  void $ forkIO $ do
    threadDelay 50000  -- 50ms
    conns <- readMVar (poolConns pool)
    case Map.lookup 1 conns of
      Just conn -> writeIORef (connAlive conn) False
      Nothing -> return ()
  -- Handle requests
  threadDelay 200000  -- 200ms, after eviction has run
  result <- handleRequest pool "hello world"
  putStrLn result
